Pick the folder on this phone or its card where your music is kept. Music Box only reads the files there to build your library, and never changes them unless you edit a song\'s details yourself. Or connect your own music server.
Plays the music on this phone and on your own music server, and internet radio.

Your library, playlists, queue, hearts and settings stay on this phone. A music server\'s password is sealed with a key in the phone\'s keystore before it is saved. Nothing is sent to the app\'s maker.

The app goes online only for what you use: your own music server (Navidrome or another Subsonic server) at the address you type in; radio.garden, to browse stations, and each station\'s own stream while it plays; and api.zippopotam.us, only for a US or Canadian postcode typed into the radio search. A server on a home network is often plain http, so what goes to it is not encrypted.
